name: CalPERS

name: NBIM (Norges Bank Investment Management)
rationale: Most AI-advanced LP publicly. ~50% of 700 staff build their own Claude-based tools in production for screening, ESG/risk monitoring across 7,000 holdings, and meeting prep; 3-year firm-wide push with AI teams, ambassadors, and mandatory training. Stops short of embedded: AI cannot make autonomous investment decisions — human oversight is non-negotiable.

name: CPP Investments
rationale: ChatGPT Enterprise deployed to ~1,800 of 2,000 eligible staff (83% activation, 84% sustained weekly use in 90 days); 528 custom GPTs built (99th percentile vs. industry median of 18); ran agent-vs-human experiments on real tasks (portfolio reconciliation, attribution, tariff scenarios) with a five-gate governance framework. Stops short of embedded: humans still frame and verify every output; org structure not yet redesigned.

name: GIC
rationale: Enterprise-wide ChatGIC (secure ChatGPT) since 2023; production AI in trading — LLMs processing Bloomberg broker-commentary streams cross-referenced with PM positions for market intelligence at scale, AI-processed broker quotes and ECM deal emails, semi-automated OTC RFQs, global algo wheels, and trader 'vibe coding' in a secure environment. Self-describes as 'early adopter' embedding AI 'across operations.' Strongest evidence is trading-desk-specific; lacks firm-wide penetration metrics, so scaling call rests on depth in the core investment function rather than disclosed org-wide adoption rates.
